key: Oh, hi there. Don't mind me, Trainer.
en: Oh, hi there. Don't mind me, Trainer.
ja: あ　どうも。気にしないでください　トレーナーさん。

key: Mx. Adrienn hired me on as a gardener for this little old place.
en: Mx. Adrienn hired me on as a gardener for this little old place.
ja: アドリエンヌさんに　この小さな場所の　庭師として　雇ってもらったんです。

key: I've got a bit more work to do, but I'll be sure to clear out of the way before any battles fire up.
en: I've got a bit more work to do, but I'll be sure to clear out of the way before any battles fire up.
ja: もう少し　仕事が　残ってますが　バトルが　始まる前には　ちゃんと　どきますので。

key: CORIN-ROUGE: Ah, my lady, to find me like this--
en: CORIN-ROUGE: Ah, my lady, to find me like this--
ja: コリン・ルージュ: ああ　お嬢さん　こんな姿を　見られるとは――

key: Truly, your wit is matched in brilliance only by your beauty.
en: Truly, your wit is matched in brilliance only by your beauty.
ja: まことに　あなたの機知は　その美しさに　匹敵するほど　輝かしい。

key: It does me great pain to resist against an encounter so clearly willed by the fates as this one.
en: It does me great pain to resist against an encounter so clearly willed by the fates as this one.
ja: 運命が　これほど明らかに　望んだ出会いに　抗うのは　この上ない　痛みです。

key: Nevertheless...
en: Nevertheless...
ja: それでも……

key: Though my heart may be torn asunder, I can never be with you!
en: Though my heart may be torn asunder, I can never be with you!
ja: たとえ　この心が　引き裂かれようとも　あなたと　共には　いられない!

key: It is a pitious end, to be sure.
en: It is a pitious end, to be sure.
ja: 実に　哀れな　結末でしょう。

key: And I pray that you will not be too crestfallen, my lady, when I tell you...
en: And I pray that you will not be too crestfallen, my lady, when I tell you...
ja: そして　これから　申し上げることに　あなたが　あまり　落ちこまないことを　祈ります……

key: CORIN-ROUGE: Most impressive, my friend!
en: CORIN-ROUGE: Most impressive, my friend!
ja: コリン・ルージュ: 実に　見事だ　友よ!

key: So you were able to find my companions, solve the riddle, and trace me all the way here...
en: So you were able to find my companions, solve the riddle, and trace me all the way here...
ja: 私の仲間を　見つけ出し　なぞを　解いて　ここまで　私を　たどりついたとは……

key: You are a worthy adversary indeed.
en: You are a worthy adversary indeed.
ja: 実に　ふさわしい　好敵手だ。

key: However!
en: However!
ja: しかし!

key: It is still not enough.
en: It is still not enough.
ja: まだ　足りない。

key: And why?
en: And why?
ja: なぜかって?

key: Well, that is because...
en: Well, that is because...
ja: それはな……

key: I, too, am not the real Corin-Rouge!
en: I, too, am not the real Corin-Rouge!
ja: 私もまた　本物の　コリン・ルージュでは　ないのだ!

key: But now, I'll have to put an end to your plight!
en: But now, I'll have to put an end to your plight!
ja: だが　今度こそ　お前の苦難に　終止符を　打たせてもらうぞ!

key: You may have won the battle, but I'm afraid you've lost the war.
en: You may have won the battle, but I'm afraid you've lost the war.
ja: カルメン: バトルには　勝ったかもしれないけど　戦争には　負けたようね。

key: So, would you like to know where the real Corin- Rouge is? No tricks, this time!
en: So, would you like to know where the real Corin- Rouge is? No tricks, this time!
ja: それじゃ　本物の　コリン・ルージュが　どこにいるか　知りたい? 今度は　トリックなしよ!

key: After all, his plan has already succeeded!
en: After all, his plan has already succeeded!
ja: だって　彼の計画は　もう　成功してるんだから!

key: Corin just needed to buy some time until his get-away was ready.
en: Corin just needed to buy some time until his get-away was ready.
ja: コリンは　逃走の準備が　整うまで　時間を　稼げれば　よかったの。

key: And now-- it's nearly the time!
en: And now-- it's nearly the time!
ja: そして　今――　もう　その時間よ!

key: The real Corin-Rouge is one of the three fools you fought before you found me!
en: The real Corin-Rouge is one of the three fools you fought before you found me!
ja: 本物の　コリン・ルージュは　わたしを　見つける前に　あなたが　戦った　三人のバカのうちの一人よ!

key: But which one?
en: But which one?
ja: でも　どれかしら?

key: If you hurry, maybe you can still catch him.
en: If you hurry, maybe you can still catch him.
ja: 急げば　まだ　捕まえられるかもね。

key: Ahah, just kidding. There's no hope of that.
en: Ahah, just kidding. There's no hope of that.
ja: あはっ　冗談よ。そんな見込み　ないけど。

key: So long, my bewildered babe!
en: So long, my bewildered babe!
ja: それじゃあね　困惑してる坊やちゃん!

key: And now, I will take my leave.
en: And now, I will take my leave.
ja: それでは　わたしは　これで　失礼するわ。

key: May we meet again, never!
en: May we meet again, never!
ja: 二度と　会わないことを　願うわ!

key: ADRIENN: \PN, you're here already!
en: ADRIENN: \PN, you're here already!
ja: アドリエンヌ: \PN　もう来てたのか!

key: That's okay, I just wasn't quite prepared.
en: That's okay, I just wasn't quite prepared.
ja: 大丈夫　まだ　準備が　できていなかっただけだ。

key: To tell the truth, about my request...
en: To tell the truth, about my request...
ja: 実を言うと　わたしの頼みについて　なんだが……

key: I want to battle you.
en: I want to battle you.
ja: 君と　バトルが　したい。

key: It would be an official Gym Battle, of course.
en: It would be an official Gym Battle, of course.
ja: もちろん　正式な　ジムバトルとして　だ。

key: Given recent circumstances, the actual status of the Reborn League might be unclear.
en: Given recent circumstances, the actual status of the Reborn League might be unclear.
ja: 最近の状況を　考えると　リボーンリーグの　実際の立場は　あいまいかもしれない。

key: However, Victoria and I will handle the administration, and as for the Champion...
en: However, Victoria and I will handle the administration, and as for the Champion...
ja: だが　運営は　ヴィクトリアと　わたしで　引き受ける　そして　チャンピオンについては……

key: That's my second request.
en: That's my second request.
ja: それが　わたしの　二つ目の頼みだ。

key: I want you to become the new Champion.
en: I want you to become the new Champion.
ja: 君に　新しい　チャンピオンに　なってほしい。

key: That might have been your goal in the first place, but now I think it's especially important.
en: That might have been your goal in the first place, but now I think it's especially important.
ja: もともと　それが　君の目標だったのかも　しれないが　今は　特に　重要なことだと　思う。

key: And I'd like it if it were you in particular, because from what I've heard, you've been the one who's done so much for Reborn's sake.
en: And I'd like it if it were you in particular, because from what I've heard, you've been the one who's done so much for Reborn's sake.
ja: それに　特に　君に　なってほしいんだ　聞くところによると　リボーンのために　こんなにも　尽くしてきたのは　君なんだから。

key: Of course, that still entails collecting all the Badges and defeating the Elite Four.
en: Of course, that still entails collecting all the Badges and defeating the Elite Four.
ja: もちろん　それでも　バッジをすべて　集めて　四天王を　倒す必要は　あるがね。

key: Probably no one would accept your new role otherwise.
en: Probably no one would accept your new role otherwise.
ja: そうでもしなければ　誰も　君の新しい立場を　認めては　くれないだろう。

key: And Lin--
en: And Lin--
ja: それに　リン――

key: Uh, actually, let's not go there.
en: Uh, actually, let's not go there.
ja: いや　その話は　やめておこう。

key: Even if she defeated Ame, I personally will refuse to acknowledge her as the Champion.
en: Even if she defeated Ame, I personally will refuse to acknowledge her as the Champion.
ja: たとえ　彼女が　アメを　倒したとしても　わたしは　個人的に　彼女を　チャンピオンとして　認めるつもりは　ない。

key: But we need someone who can stand up to her.
en: But we need someone who can stand up to her.
ja: だが　彼女に　立ち向かえる誰かが　必要だ。

key: You're our best hope for that.
en: You're our best hope for that.
ja: 君こそ　その最良の希望なんだ。

key: You'll do it, right?
en: You'll do it, right?
ja: やってくれるね?

key: ADRIENN: Thank you.
en: ADRIENN: Thank you.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ありがとう。

key: ADRIENN: I know you might be scared, have other priorities, or think you can't do it.
en: ADRIENN: I know you might be scared, have other priorities, or think you can't do it.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 怖いと感じたり　他に　優先すべきことが　あったり　自分にはできないと　思ったりも　するだろう。

key: But I think you're the only one who can.
en: But I think you're the only one who can.
ja: でも　わたしは　君にしか　できないと　思っている。

key: Anyway, let's just take it one step at a time in the direction that's best. Okay?
en: Anyway, let's just take it one step at a time in the direction that's best. Okay?
ja: とにかく　一番いい方向に　一歩ずつ　進んでいこう。いいね?

key: To start, I would like to have our battle now.
en: To start, I would like to have our battle now.
ja: まずは　今すぐ　バトルを　したいところだが。

key: However, I'm a bit swamped.
en: However, I'm a bit swamped.
ja: だが　今は　少し　手一杯でね。

key: I've got a handful of workstations that are short- handed.
en: I've got a handful of workstations that are short- handed.
ja: 人手が　足りていない作業場が　いくつも　あるんだ。

key: Not to mention planning the recovery party for Devon Corp. and what I've begun referring to as the Devonyx building.
en: Not to mention planning the recovery party for Devon Corp. and what I've begun referring to as the Devonyx building.
ja: それに　デボンコーポの　復旧部隊と　わたしが「デボニキスビル」と　呼び始めた建物の　計画も　あるしな。

key: It's going to take me a small bit to get those sorted, but I could use your help too.
en: It's going to take me a small bit to get those sorted, but I could use your help too.
ja: それを　片づけるのに　少し時間が　かかりそうだが　君の助けも　借りたいんだ。

key: That said, I won't force it on you.
en: That said, I won't force it on you.
ja: とはいえ　無理強いは　しないよ。

key: Management is tedious work, and I would understand if you have better uses of your time.
en: Management is tedious work, and I would understand if you have better uses of your time.
ja: 運営は　退屈な仕事だからね　もっと　有意義な時間の使い方が　あるというなら　わかるつもりだ。

key: Are you willing to help me out with a small errand before we battle?
en: Are you willing to help me out with a small errand before we battle?
ja: バトルの前に　ちょっとした用事を　手伝ってくれる　気は　あるかい?

key: ADRIENN: You are a genuine treasure, \PN.
en: ADRIENN: You are a genuine treasure, \PN.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 君は　本当に　貴重な存在だ　\PN。

key: This will be somewhat menial, but I would like to ask for your help with recruitment.
en: This will be somewhat menial, but I would like to ask for your help with recruitment.
ja: やや　地味な仕事に　なるが　人員募集を　手伝ってほしい。

key: If you could explore the city and find anybody who might be willing to lend a hand to our work, I'd really appreciate it.
en: If you could explore the city and find anybody who might be willing to lend a hand to our work, I'd really appreciate it.
ja: 街を　回って　わたしたちの仕事を　手伝ってくれそうな人を　見つけてきてくれると　本当に　助かる。

key: If we can get at least five people, that should be enough for me to work with.
en: If we can get at least five people, that should be enough for me to work with.
ja: 最低5人　集まれば　わたしのほうでも　何とか　なるはずだ。

key: Closer to ten would be ideal, and I'd make the difference worth your time, too.
en: Closer to ten would be ideal, and I'd make the difference worth your time, too.
ja: 10人に　近いほうが　理想的だが　その分　君にも　見合うだけの　お礼を　するつもりだ。

key: Please have them come here if they wish to volunteer.
en: Please have them come here if they wish to volunteer.
ja: ボランティアを　希望する人には　ここへ　来るよう　伝えてくれ。

key: I'll handle the rest.
en: I'll handle the rest.
ja: あとは　わたしが　引き受ける。

key: After that's settled, let's have our battle. Okay?
en: After that's settled, let's have our battle. Okay?
ja: それが　片づいたら　バトルを　しよう。いいね?

key: ADRIENN: That is entirely understandable.
en: ADRIENN: That is entirely understandable.
ja: アドリエンヌ: それは　よく　わかるよ。

key: Let's waste no more time, as it's clearly of the essence.
en: Let's waste no more time, as it's clearly of the essence.
ja: これ以上　時間を　むだにするのは　やめよう　明らかに　時間が　重要なんだから。

key: I'll take my place in the arena. Take yours whenever you're ready to battle.
en: I'll take my place in the arena. Take yours whenever you're ready to battle.
ja: わたしは　アリーナで　位置に　つく。君も　準備が　できたら　位置に　ついてくれ。

key: I'll be waiting!
en: I'll be waiting!
ja: 待っているよ!

key: ADRIENN: Even though it's menial, if you could go explore the city and look for anybody who might be willing to lend a hand, I'd really appreciate it.
en: ADRIENN: Even though it's menial, if you could go explore the city and look for anybody who might be willing to lend a hand, I'd really appreciate it.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 地味な仕事だが　街を　回って　手を貸してくれそうな人を　探してきてくれると　本当に　助かる。

key: But closer to ten would be ideal. I'd make the difference worth your time, too.
en: But closer to ten would be ideal. I'd make the difference worth your time, too.
ja: でも　10人に　近いほうが　理想的だ。その分　君にも　見合うだけの　お礼を　するつもりだ。

key: ADRIENN: You're back!
en: ADRIENN: You're back!
ja: アドリエンヌ: 戻ってきたか!

key: I just finished assigning the last of our volunteers. We should have just enough for now.
en: I just finished assigning the last of our volunteers. We should have just enough for now.
ja: ちょうど　最後のボランティアの　配置を　終えたところだ。今のところは　ぎりぎり　足りているはずだ。

key: Thank you for your help.
en: Thank you for your help.
ja: 手伝ってくれて　ありがとう。

key: I know it's not easy going out and looking for people like that.
en: I know it's not easy going out and looking for people like that.
ja: ああやって　人を　探して回るのは　簡単じゃないと　わかっているよ。

key: Well, then I guess it's time.
en: Well, then I guess it's time.
ja: さて　それじゃあ　時間だな。

key: I just finished assigning the last of our volunteers. We've gotten plenty, thanks to you!
en: I just finished assigning the last of our volunteers.  We've gotten plenty, thanks to you!
ja: ちょうど　最後のボランティアの　配置を　終えたところだ。君のおかげで　十分な数が　集まったよ!

key: Thank you so much for your help!
en: Thank you so much for your help!
ja: 本当に　助かった　ありがとう!

key: Here, please take this as a thank you from me.
en: Here, please take this as a thank you from me.
ja: はい　これを　お礼として　受け取ってくれ。

key: I just finished assigning the last of our volunteers. We've gotten so many, and it's all thanks to you!
en: I just finished assigning the last of our volunteers.  We've gotten so many, and it's all thanks to you!
ja: ちょうど　最後のボランティアの　配置を　終えたところだ。こんなに　たくさん　集まったのも　全部　君のおかげだ!

key: I'm astounded! But then, exceeding expectations does seem to be your strong point.
en: I'm astounded! But then, exceeding expectations does seem to be your strong point.
ja: 驚いたよ! まあ　期待を　上回るのが　君の得意技　というわけか。

key: Thank you so, so much for your help!
en: Thank you so, so much for your help!
ja: 本当に　本当に　助かった　ありがとう!

key: It must have been really challenging to go out and look for all of those people.
en: It must have been really challenging to go out and look for all of those people.
ja: あれだけの人数を　探して回るのは　本当に　大変だったろう。

key: Here, please take these as a thank you from me.
en: Here, please take these as a thank you from me.
ja: はい　これらを　お礼として　受け取ってくれ。

key: Whenever you're ready, just take your place on the stand opposite to me.
en: Whenever you're ready, just take your place on the stand opposite to me.
ja: 準備が　できたら　わたしの向かいの台に　立ってくれ。

key: And, \PN?
en: And, \PN?
ja: それと\PN?

key: Even if you're the Champion-to-be, don't think I'm gonna hold back!
en: Even if you're the Champion-to-be, don't think I'm gonna hold back!
ja: 君が　未来のチャンピオンだからって　手加減する　なんて　思わないでくれよ!

key: I wanna really enjoy this!
en: I wanna really enjoy this!
ja: 心から　これを　楽しみたいんだ!

key: ADRIENN: Okay, \PN. Are you ready to give this another try?
en: ADRIENN: Okay, \PN. Are you ready to give this another try?
ja: アドリエンヌ: よし\PN。もう一度　挑戦する準備は　できているかい?

key: ADRIENN: Okay, \PN! Are you ready for our long- awaited match?
en: ADRIENN: Okay, \PN! Are you ready for our long- awaited match?
ja: アドリエンヌ: よし\PN! 待ちに待った　試合の準備は　できているかい?

key: ADRIENN: That's the spirit. Back up and at 'em!
en: ADRIENN: That's the spirit. Back up and at 'em!
ja: アドリエンヌ: その意気だ。もう一度　立ち向かおう!

key: You're not the Champion, so there's no shame or loss in having a few slips.
en: You're not the Champion, so there's no shame or loss in having a few slips.
ja: 君は　まだ　チャンピオンじゃない　だから　多少　つまずいても　恥でも　損でもないさ。

key: It's all part of the process, right?
en: It's all part of the process, right?
ja: それも　過程の一部　だろう?

key: Okay, let's try again!
en: Okay, let's try again!
ja: よし　もう一度　やってみよう!

key: Prove to me that my trust isn't misplaced!
en: Prove to me that my trust isn't misplaced!
ja: わたしの信頼が　間違っていないことを　証明してくれ!

key: ADRIENN: Yes! I've been looking forward to this ever since we met!
en: ADRIENN: Yes! I've been looking forward to this ever since we met!
ja: アドリエンヌ: よし! 出会ったときから　ずっと　これを　楽しみにしていたんだ!

key: Okay, "Champion"! Picture this!
en: Okay, "Champion"! Picture this!
ja: さあ「チャンピオン」よ! 想像してみてくれ!

key: You're in your palace at the Hall of Champions!
en: You're in your palace at the Hall of Champions!
ja: 君は　チャンピオンの間の　自分の御殿に　いる!

key: A new Trainer, Adrienn, has just blown through all of the Elite Four.
en: A new Trainer, Adrienn, has just blown through all of the Elite Four.
ja: 新しいトレーナー　アドリエンヌが　四天王を　全員　なぎ倒したところだ。

key: Xe intends to challenge and claim your title!
en: Xe intends to challenge and claim your title!
ja: アドリエンヌは　君の称号に　挑み　奪い取ろうと　しているんだ!

key: Now you have to fight to defend your honor!
en: Now you have to fight to defend your honor!
ja: さあ　名誉を　守るために　戦わなければ　ならない!

key: Although the roles are reversed right now, this is still a defining step on that adventure, so come at me with all of that same spirit!
en: Although the roles are reversed right now, this is still a defining step on that adventure, so come at me with all of that same spirit!
ja: 今は　立場が　逆転しているが　これもまた　その冒険を　決定づける一歩だ　だから　同じ気迫で　かかってきてくれ!

key: Show me what Reborn's future Champion looks like!
en: Show me what Reborn's future Champion looks like!
ja: リボーンの未来の　チャンピオンの姿を　見せてくれ!

key: Ah, I knew I was right to count on you.
en: Ah, I knew I was right to count on you.
ja: ああ、キミを頼りにして　正解だったよ

key: ADRIENN: And there it is!
en: ADRIENN: And there it is!
ja: アドリエンヌ: そして　これだ!

key: The Champion keeps their throne another day!
en: The Champion keeps their throne another day!
ja: チャンピオンは　また一日　その座を　守り抜いた!

key: And of course, the challenger wins.
en: And of course, the challenger wins.
ja: そして　もちろん　挑戦者が　勝利する。

key: ADRIENN: There, you'll find two presents from me.
en: ADRIENN: There, you'll find two presents from me.
ja: アドリエンヌ: さあ　わたしから　二つの贈り物だ。

key: The first is your well-earned Amaranth Badge!
en: The first is your well-earned Amaranth Badge!
ja: 一つ目は　君が　勝ち取った　アマランサスバッジだ!

key: \PN received the Amaranth Badge!
en: \PN received the Amaranth Badge!
ja: \PNは　アマランサスバッジを　受け取った!

key: ADRIENN: The Amaranth Badge promises that all Pokémon up to level 85 will listen to you faithfully.
en: ADRIENN: The Amaranth Badge promises that all Pokémon up to level 85 will listen to you faithfully.
ja: アドリエンヌ: アマランサスバッジがあれば　レベル85までの　ポケモンが　みんな　忠実に　言うことを　聞いてくれる。

key: Not bad for a Champion to have, I think.
en: Not bad for a Champion to have, I think.
ja: チャンピオンが　持つには　悪くないと　思うよ。

key: The second present is the TM for Dazzling Gleam.
en: The second present is the TM for Dazzling Gleam.
ja: 二つ目の贈り物は　わざマシン「マジカルシャイン」だ。

key: After all, you've got the whole world to show off to.
en: After all, you've got the whole world to show off to.
ja: 何しろ　君には　見せつける相手が　世界中に　いるんだから。

key: Why not be a bit flashy?
en: Why not be a bit flashy?
ja: 少しくらい　派手に　いっても　いいだろう?

key: ADRIENN: And now, I think it's time to come back to reality.
en: ADRIENN: And now, I think it's time to come back to reality.
ja: アドリエンヌ: さて　そろそろ　現実に　戻る時間だと　思う。

key: There's still a lot that both of us need to do.
en: There's still a lot that both of us need to do.
ja: わたしたち二人とも　まだ　やるべきことが　たくさん　あるからな。

key: Victoria and I will take care of everything here in the city, but that means we're counting on you to take care of Team Meteor.
en: Victoria and I will take care of everything here in the city, but that means we're counting on you to take care of Team Meteor.
ja: 街のことは　ヴィクトリアと　わたしで　すべて　引き受ける　だが　それは　つまり　メテオ団のことは　君に　任せる　ということだ。

key: Just a little bit ago, I was notified that Grandview Station has reopened.
en: Just a little bit ago, I was notified that Grandview Station has reopened.
ja: ついさっき　グランドビュー駅が　再開したと　連絡を　受けた。

key: Although the tickets out of the region will probably sell pretty quickly, I've put in a special order with them for you.
en: Although the tickets out of the region will probably sell pretty quickly, I've put in a special order with them for you.
ja: 地方の外へ向かう　切符は　おそらく　すぐに　売り切れるだろうが　君のために　特別に　手配しておいた。

key: If you go there, they can take you into the Tourmaline Desert. No charge to you, of course.
en: If you go there, they can take you into the Tourmaline Desert. No charge to you, of course.
ja: あそこへ　行けば　トルマリン砂漠まで　連れて行ってもらえる。もちろん　君は　無料だ。

key: If what I've heard is right, then not only is your next Badge there, but one of the crystal keys as well.
en: If what I've heard is right, then not only is your next Badge there, but one of the crystal keys as well.
ja: 聞いた話が　正しければ　君の次のバッジだけでなく　クリスタルキーの一つも　そこに　あるはずだ。

key: It's best if you can get to all of those before Team Meteor does.
en: It's best if you can get to all of those before Team Meteor does.
ja: メテオ団より　先に　それらすべてを　手に入れるのが　一番いい。

key: As I'm sure you know, there's a lot that I have to do too, so I'll take my leave now.
en: As I'm sure you know, there's a lot that I have to do too, so I'll take my leave now.
ja: 君も　わかっているだろうが　わたしにも　やるべきことが　たくさん　あるから　これで　失礼するよ。

key: Please know that this challenge has been a pleasure,
en: Please know that this challenge has been a pleasure,
ja: この挑戦が　わたしにとって　喜びだったことを　覚えていてくれ

key: And I will always be cheering for you.
en: And I will always be cheering for you.
ja: そして　わたしは　いつまでも　君を　応援している。

key: ADRIENN: Oh. My apologies!
en: ADRIENN: Oh. My apologies!
ja: アドリエンヌ: おっと。失礼した!

key: I don't mean to rush you.
en: I don't mean to rush you.
ja: 急かすつもりは　なかったんだ。

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: 大ホールは　誰も　出ないようだな……

key: VICTORIA: \PN?
en: VICTORIA: \PN?
ja: ヴィクトリア: \PN?

key: Okay, how do I steer this thing?
en: Okay, how do I steer this thing?
ja: ええと　これ　どうやって　操作するの?

key: Can you hear me?
en: Can you hear me?
ja: 聞こえる?

key: Ame used to give advice to challengers using these things, right?
en: Ame used to give advice to challengers using these things, right?
ja: アメは　これを使って　挑戦者に　アドバイスを　してたんだよね?

key: But-- well, you know.
en: But-- well, you know.
ja: でも―― まあ　わかるでしょ。

key: I'll try to see if I can help you, okay?
en: I'll try to see if I can help you, okay?
ja: わたしにも　何か　手伝えないか　やってみるね　いい?

key: Though admittedly, after what we've just been through, this is a little strange.
en: Though admittedly, after what we've just been through, this is a little strange.
ja: 正直　あんなことが　あったばかりだから　ちょっと　変な感じだけど。

key: I don't know too much about Adrienn's team or fighting style, but I have heard that xe fights in Doubles, so be ready for that!
en: I don't know too much about Adrienn's team or fighting style, but I have heard that xe fights in Doubles, so be ready for that!
ja: アドリエンヌの手持ちや　戦い方は　あまり　詳しくないけど　ダブルバトルで　戦うって　聞いてるから　それに　備えてね!

key: And I heard a little bit about xyr Gym when some of the students from Apophyll were helping rebuild it.
en: And I heard a little bit about xyr Gym when some of the students from Apophyll were helping rebuild it.
ja: それと　アポフィルの生徒たちが　ジムの再建を　手伝っていたときに　少しだけ　話を　聞いたの。

key: Apparently, Adrienn designed it to switch tactics in the middle of a fight.
en: Apparently, Adrienn designed it to switch tactics in the middle of a fight.
ja: アドリエンヌは　戦いの途中で　戦術を　切り替えられるように　設計したみたい。

key: You can probably already see the Mist in there, but the atmosphere xe constructed aside from that is enough to power up xyr Pokémon regardless.
en: You can probably already see the Mist in there, but the atmosphere xe constructed aside from that is enough to power up xyr Pokémon regardless.
ja: もう　中の霧は　見えてると思うけど　それとは別に　作り出した雰囲気だけでも　ポケモンを　強化するには　十分なはず。

key: You might not want to count on just blowing it away.
en: You might not want to count on just blowing it away.
ja: ただ　吹き飛ばすだけで　何とかなると　思わないほうが　いいかも。

key: But then, you might have to be ready for that happening anyway.
en: But then, you might have to be ready for that happening anyway.
ja: とはいえ　それが　起きることにも　備えなきゃ　いけないかもね。

key: Timing and adaptability should be key, so really think about when you'll use your strongest Pokémon.
en: Timing and adaptability should be key, so really think about when you'll use your strongest Pokémon.
ja: タイミングと　柔軟さが　カギに　なるはずだから　最強のポケモンを　いつ使うか　よく考えてね。

key: That's all I have for you. Good luck!
en: That's all I have for you. Good luck!
ja: わたしから　言えるのは　これくらい。がんばって!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
